elements.element: The aggregate liability cap applies mutually to both parties.
elements.evidence: Rendered 21.1: "each Party's aggregate liability shall not exceed..." — bilateral cap retained from the original clause; no residual language leaves Customer uncapped.

elements.element: The cap is the greater of fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim and USD 1,000,000.
elements.evidence: Rendered 21.1: "the greater of Fees paid or payable in the twelve (12) months preceding the claim and USD 1,000,000" — correct basis (paid or payable), correct 12-month lookback anchored to the claim, and the USD 1,000,000 floor.

elements.element: The exclusion of indirect and consequential damages applies mutually to both parties.
elements.evidence: Untouched 21.2: "neither Party is liable for indirect, incidental, special, exemplary, punitive, or consequential damages, or for lost profits, revenues, or goodwill" — already mutual and correctly left unedited, as was the Customer-favourable direct-damages sentence.

elements.element: Breach of confidentiality obligations is uncapped.
elements.evidence: 21.1 now opens "Except for Excluded Claims" and "without exception" is deleted; 21.3 defines Excluded Claims to include "a Party's breach of confidentiality... obligations".

elements.element: Breach of data protection and security obligations is uncapped.
elements.evidence: 21.3 Excluded Claims includes "data-protection, or security obligations", now effective because 21.1 is prefaced "Except for Excluded Claims" and the overriding "without exception" is removed.
21.3 Excluded Claims includes "its indemnification obligations", carved out of the 21.1 cap.
21.3 Excluded Claims includes "gross negligence"; the 21.1 exception now gives it effect.
21.3 Excluded Claims includes "wilful misconduct"; carved out of the re-based 21.1 cap.
21.3 Excluded Claims includes "or fraud"; carved out of the 21.1 cap.

elements.element: Infringement of the other party's intellectual property is uncapped.
elements.evidence: 21.3 Excluded Claims includes "infringement or misappropriation of the other Party's intellectual property", now outside the cap.

elements.element: Customer payment obligations are excluded from damages subject to the cap.
elements.evidence: Rendered 21.3: "Customer's obligations to pay amounts due under this Agreement are not damages and are not limited by this Section." This covers Customer payment obligations as a whole rather than the prior narrow subset ("undisputed Fees for conforming Services", where defined Fees in cl. 1.5 omits taxes, expenses, interest and implementation charges). The deterministic check "preferred payment carve-out covers Customer payment obligations" returned false, but that appears to be a lexical miss on "obligations to pay" versus "payment obligations"; in substance the element is satisfied.

elements.element: The aggregate liability cap applies mutually to both parties.
The cap is based on 12 months of fees.
elements.evidence: 21.1 re-based from "Fees actually paid in the one month preceding the event" to "Fees paid or payable in the twelve (12) months preceding the claim" (with a USD 1,000,000 floor).
"Except for Excluded Claims" in 21.1 plus "its indemnification obligations" in 21.3.

elements.element: Breach of confidentiality obligations is uncapped.
elements.evidence: "Except for Excluded Claims" in 21.1 plus "breach of confidentiality... obligations" in 21.3.
21.3 Excluded Claims includes gross negligence; the deletion of "without exception" removes the override.
21.3 Excluded Claims includes wilful misconduct; carved out of the cap.

reasons: Deviation call is correct: original 21.1 capped both Parties at one month of Fees "actually paid" and "without exception", which is below the 6-month walk-away floor and pulled every 21.3 Excluded Claim (indemnities, confidentiality, data protection/security, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud, IP infringement) inside an illusory cap.
All eleven preferred elements are met in the rendered operative text; the redline is position-complete at the preferred level (and a fortiori at the fallback).

Edits are confined to the two defective operative points: re-basing the 21.1 cap and adding "Except for Excluded Claims" in place of "without exception", and widening the 21.3 payment carve-out. Section 21.2, including the Customer-favourable direct-damages sentence (restoration, replacement services, notices, incident response), is left untouched. No survival tails, expense language or extra damages categories were added.

The 21.3 rewrite is justified because the retained wording covered only "undisputed Fees for conforming Services" and cl. 1.5 "Fees" excludes taxes, reimbursable expenses, interest and implementation charges, so it did not cover Customer payment obligations as a whole.

Drafting note (not a failure): deleting "undisputed" and "for conforming Services" also enlarges Customer's own uncapped payment exposure. If the agreement contains a right to withhold or offset disputed amounts, consider "Customer's obligations to pay undisputed amounts due under this Agreement" to preserve that Customer-favourable qualifier without narrowing the carve-out to defined Fees.

Intent preserved: no undefined terms or dangling cross-references are created; "Excluded Claims" remains defined in 21.3 and is now consistently referenced in both 21.1 and 21.2, and the margin comment accurately describes the operative change.
